slides.heading: Sets per week is the number that matters.
slides.supporting: Not the number on the bar.

slides.heading: Count working sets, per muscle, per week.
slides.supporting: That is the unit that tracks how much real work a muscle got.

slides.heading: There is a floor and there is a ceiling.
slides.supporting: Below the floor you undertrain. Past the ceiling you recover slowly and progress stalls.

slides.heading: More sets is not automatically more progress.
slides.supporting: Adding volume you cannot recover from just costs you recovery.

slides.heading: Add work only when the signals say so.
slides.supporting: Steady logs, sets completed as planned, recovery holding up.

slides.heading: Volyume tracks your weekly sets and decides when to add.
slides.supporting: Advanced progression watches the volume and moves it only when the data supports it.
